sentences.en: You'll strain your eyes trying to read in this light.
sentences.zh: 在这种光线下看书会伤眼睛。

sentences.en: Their marriage has been strained lately because of financial problems.
sentences.zh: 由于经济问题，他们的婚姻最近有些紧张。

sentences.en: His voice was strained from singing along at the concert.
sentences.zh: 他在演唱会上跟着唱声音都有点沙哑了。

senses.zh: 张力；拉紧；负担；扭伤；血缘
